_comment: Mutation testing: breaks the source on purpose and checks the tests notice. A mutant that
leaves the suite green is a bug the tests cannot see — unlike line coverage, this cannot be
satisfied by executing code without asserting on it.
Full explanation, glossary, scope rationale and current numbers: docs/tools/mutation-testing.md.
This file carries only the settings themselves.
`concurrency` below is the fallback for a bare `npx stryker run`. `npm run test:mutation`
goes through `scripts/run-mutation-tests.ts`, which reads STRYKER_CONCURRENCY from `.env`
and passes it as `--concurrency`, and an explicit CLI flag always wins over this file.
